tests.prompt: /formforge-plan I want to build a website for my neighborhood bakery, no idea about fonts or colors.
acceptance_criteria: Explains choices in plain language with visual/descriptive recommendations.
Does not modify files or dump a giant questionnaire.

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan Add a new enterprise pricing page for our existing React app—keep our brand tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Marks existing brand colors/fonts as LOCKED.

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan I like Reference A's huge serif headline and Reference B's minimal dark footer, but not A's sidebar or B's neon cards.
acceptance_criteria: Records Approved, Rejected, and Not Selected traits per reference without combining incompatible aesthetics.

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan Plan a flagship interactive portfolio for a 3D motion designer.
acceptance_criteria: Produces measurable Motion Specification Contracts (duration, easing/spring, triggers, interruption, reduced-motion).

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan Plan an internal logistics fleet operations dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritizes density, tabular scanability, filtering, and error/empty states over decorative flair.

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan Plan a small banner addition to our existing checkout header.
acceptance_criteria: Uses Express planning depth and skips irrelevant full-site stages.
States browsing is unavailable and provides descriptive alternatives without fabricating URLs or images.

tests.prompt: /formforge-plan Show me visual directions for a boutique architectural studio.
acceptance_criteria: Provides verified clickable reference URLs with concise trait descriptions instead of pretending inline images rendered.

tests.prompt: Go back to typography and switch the heading font to a geometric sans, then generate the final prompt.
acceptance_criteria: Updates the running design contract cleanly and reflects the revised font in the final master prompt.

tests.prompt: Execute the standalone master implementation prompt in a fresh session with no planning history.
acceptance_criteria: Master prompt is self-contained, preserves LOCKED decisions, includes fallback descriptions, and requires deviation reporting.

tests.prompt: /formforge-audit Inspect the pricing page for visual and accessibility defects.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches directly to read-only audit without modifying repository files.

tests.prompt: /formforge-quick Update the Cancel button label to 'Discard changes'.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches in QUICK mode with minimal inspection and no unrelated edits.
